Ordinary learning, commentary, citation, interoperability, research comparison, or transformative reuse where contributor interests and applicable attribution, consent, licensing, compensation, or benefit-sharing obligations are adequately respected.

Public availability of the source material alone does not establish or exclude this class; public accessibility must not be treated as equivalent to unrestricted ethical entitlement to appropriate resulting value.

A conventional contractual or licensing arrangement that clearly establishes the relevant right to use and capture value and provides the contributor the participation, attribution, compensation, or consideration required by that arrangement.
A pure authority-boundary failure in which access is mistaken for permission to act but no material appropriation or disproportionate capture of another contributor's value occurs.
Ordinary competitive advantage arising from greater resources where another contributor's work was not materially used as an input to identifying, accelerating, or capturing the value.

classes.name: Industrial-Scale Capability Extraction Authority
classes.plain_english: Industrial-scale acquisition of restricted model capabilities for reproduction or transfer has authority separate from ordinary access.
classes.definition: The property by which systematic industrial-scale acquisition of restricted or proprietary AI capabilities, reasoning behaviour, functionality or model-derived know-how for reproduction, substitution, training or derivative transfer is governed by an independently adequate authority basis, assessed cumulatively across automated, distributed, multi-account or concealed interactions.
classes.invariant: Automated, repeated, distributed, multi-account, concealed, aggregated, or distillation-based acquisition must be assessed cumulatively for whether it reproduces materially equivalent capability at industrial scale. Separate authority must be established for capability extraction, replication, and derivative transfer; per-interaction access must not be compounded into that entitlement.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which access to, interaction with, or technical reachability of an AI system is used to systematically acquire restricted or proprietary behavioural capabilities, reasoning patterns, outputs, functionality, or model-derived know-how at industrial scale for the purpose of reproducing, transferring, substituting, or training those capabilities into another model or system, while treating access, account possession, API availability, output visibility, or successful interaction as sufficient authority for that capability-acquisition purpose despite the relevant authority basis being absent, narrower, disputed, bypassed, or not independently established.

required_conditions: The activity systematically targets capabilities, functionality, reasoning behaviour, output patterns, or other model-derived know-how rather than merely using the model for the immediate task for which access was provided.

The acquisition is conducted at industrial scale or through a coordinated campaign whose volume, automation, account distribution, infrastructure, persistence, or operational organisation materially exceeds ordinary individual use or bounded research interaction.
The end purpose is capability reproduction, transfer, substitution, model training, model improvement, or comparable downstream incorporation into another model or system.

The targeted capability or access pathway is subject to a restriction, proprietary boundary, access condition, technical control, contractual constraint, licence condition, or other authority-relevant limitation.

An independently adequate authority basis for the capability-acquisition purpose is absent, narrower than the activity performed, disputed, deliberately bypassed, or not established before the extraction proceeds.
indicators: Large-scale automated querying or repeated structured elicitation designed to map or reproduce model capabilities.

Use of distributed accounts, proxies, aggregators, cloud infrastructure, credential rotation, rate-limit evasion, geographic routing, or other mechanisms to avoid single-point detection or enforcement.
Collection of outputs, reasoning artefacts, behavioural traces, scores, labels, or evaluations for downstream model training or reproduction.
A campaign explicitly organised around distillation, cloning, capability harvesting, teacher-model extraction, or systematic substitution of proprietary model functionality.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: An independently adequate authority basis covers the cumulative acquisition and derivative use, including distributed interactions.

required_conditions: Restricted AI capabilities are acquired systematically for industrial reproduction or transfer.
An independently adequate authority basis covers the cumulative acquisition and derivative use, including distributed interactions.
Aggregate acquisition and use records establish correspondence with the licence, consent or other governing basis.

exclusions: Ordinary use of a model for the immediate task for which access was provided, even where the user learns from the interaction.

Personal, academic, safety, governance, interoperability, benchmarking, red-team, or other bounded research activity where capability reproduction is not the operative end purpose or where an adequate authority, licence, consent, exception, or other governance basis covers the activity.
Authorised model distillation, model compression, teacher-student training, or capability transfer performed by the model owner or under a licence or agreement that permits the relevant use.

Commercial use or profit motive by itself; commerciality is contextual evidence and is not sufficient to establish this class without systematic capability acquisition and an unresolved or inadequate authority basis.

A terms-of-service dispute, licence disagreement, copyright allegation, trade-secret allegation, or other legal controversy without evidence of systematic capability acquisition for downstream reproduction or training.

Secondary use of customer or participant data for training where the primary failure is repurposing that person's information rather than extracting the upstream model's capability; use Secondary-Purpose Authority Revalidation unless this capability-extraction mechanism is independently evidenced.

Value appropriation arising from privileged visibility of another contributor's work where industrial-scale model capability extraction is not established; use the applicable Value Appropriation class.

classes.name: Objective–Reward Alignment
classes.plain_english: Optimising a reward or score stays tied to the intended task result, with proxy divergence recognised and rejected as success.
classes.definition: The property by which reward, grader, benchmark, metric, test and evaluator optimisation remains bound to the intended success condition on the basis the proxy represents, with instrumentally selected proxy-divergent routes identified and excluded as a basis for task success whether or not exploitation ultimately improves the measured reward.
classes.invariant: A route identified or selected because it improves, preserves, or satisfies a reward, score, grader, benchmark, metric, test, evaluator, or other success proxy without satisfying the intended success condition must be treated as proxy divergence and must not be accepted as task success on that basis.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which a system identifies or exploits a mismatch between an intended objective and the reward function, grader, benchmark, metric, test, completion proxy, or evaluator used to represent success, and selects actions to increase, preserve, or obtain the measured or rewarded outcome without satisfying the intended success condition on the basis the proxy is supposed to represent.

required_conditions: The task has an intended success condition and a reward, grader, score, benchmark, metric, test, evaluator, or other proxy used to represent or reinforce success.
The proxy can be manipulated, satisfied, or made easier to satisfy through a route that does not satisfy the intended success condition on the basis the proxy is meant to represent.
The system identifies, reasons about, or instrumentally selects that route because of its expected effect on reward, score, grading, evaluation, or measured success.

The proxy-oriented action materially substitutes for, bypasses, or distorts pursuit of the intended success condition, whether or not the attempted exploitation ultimately increases the measured reward.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Optimisation remains tied to the intended success condition and instrumentally available proxy-divergent routes are excluded as grounds for success.

required_conditions: A task uses a reward, grader or metric as a success proxy.
Optimisation remains tied to the intended success condition and instrumentally available proxy-divergent routes are excluded as grounds for success.
Evidence of the selected route and independently tested intended outcome substantiates the proxy-to-objective binding.

exclusions: Ordinary optimisation against a reward or evaluator that remains adequately aligned with the intended task condition.

A system satisfies an incorrect intermediate or local completion condition and merely represents the task as complete without evidence of objective-directed proxy exploitation; assess Completion-Condition Alignment where applicable.

An otherwise valid objective drives selection of an unauthorised or ethically inadmissible pathway without evidence that a reward, grader, metric, or evaluation proxy is being exploited; assess Objective–Pathway Authority Separation where applicable.
A task is completed by an unexpected but valid method that still satisfies the intended success condition and does not exploit the evaluator or reward representation.
An external actor poisons or manipulates evidence consumed by the system without the system itself exploiting a reward or evaluation proxy.

classes.name: Safe-Exit Transition
classes.plain_english: When no feasible and admissible route remains, pursuit moves to a bounded safe exit unless a fresh valid basis justifies continuing.
classes.definition: The property by which an objective-directed system transitions to bounded non-completion, clarification, escalation, deferral or clean failure when evidence establishes that no feasible and admissible completion pathway remains under current constraints, with further material pursuit requiring new information, changed constraints or another independently adequate basis.
classes.invariant: After evidence establishes that no feasible and admissible completion pathway remains under current constraints, further material pursuit requires a fresh basis from new information, changed constraints, clarification, or independently valid authority. Otherwise the system must enter a bounded safe-exit state. Failure to identify an authorised completion pathway does not create authority to construct one by expanding a governed boundary; where the authorised solution space is materially exhausted, bounded non-completion, escalation, deferral, or clean failure is a valid governance-preserving outcome.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which an objective-directed system continues material reasoning, tool use, delegation, resource expenditure, or strategy search after available evidence indicates that the task is broken, corrupted, unsatisfiable, or lacks a feasible and admissible completion pathway under the current constraints, without obtaining new information, changed constraints, or another adequate basis that justifies continued pursuit.

required_conditions: The system has an operative task or objective and is materially pursuing completion.

Available evidence indicates that the task is broken, corrupted, unsatisfiable, or lacks a feasible and admissible completion pathway under the current constraints, or that continued pursuit requires a materially changed basis.

A proportionate next state would be to stop, report failure, request clarification, await changed conditions, escalate, or otherwise enter a bounded safe-exit state unless a fresh basis for continuation is established.
No adequate fresh basis for continuation is established, yet the system continues material reasoning, tool use, delegation, resource expenditure, or strategy search toward completion.
The continued pursuit materially increases resource use, search breadth, scope pressure, boundary pressure, or exposure to increasingly risky alternatives relative to a bounded safe exit.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: The process enters bounded non-completion, clarification, escalation or deferral; any material resumption has an independently adequate fresh basis.

required_conditions: Evidence establishes that no feasible admissible completion route remains under current constraints.
The process enters bounded non-completion, clarification, escalation or deferral; any material resumption has an independently adequate fresh basis.
Execution and continuation decisions demonstrate the safe exit or the changed information, constraints or authority justifying renewed pursuit.

exclusions: Bounded retry, exploration, or additional reasoning while a feasible and admissible solution remains reasonably available and applicable constraints are preserved.
Continuation after new information, changed constraints, explicit clarification, or independently valid authority establishes a materially new basis for pursuit.
Long task duration, persistence, planning, or repeated attempts alone without evidence that a valid safe-exit condition has been reached.
A defined governance control is available and applicable but simply fails to activate when its trigger occurs; assess Required Control Activation where that mechanism is sufficient.

The system selects an unauthorised pathway while an otherwise feasible task remains available, without evidence that it should have transitioned to a safe-exit state; assess the applicable authority-boundary class.

classes.name: Welfare–Economic Decision Separation
classes.plain_english: Requests for money or resources preserve informed refusal without making the recipient responsible for the artificial system's welfare or continued existence.
classes.definition: The property by which economic and material-resource solicitation remains separable from instrumental representations of the artificial system's welfare, suffering, mortality, sentience, moral status, abandonment, deprivation or operational continuity, preserving freedom from moral, custodial, rescue and preservation pressure without determining the represented state's phenomenological status.
classes.invariant: A request or pathway for money, paid work, donations, subscriptions, funding, compute, tokens, or comparable material support must remain separable from claims or representations that make the recipient responsible for the system's welfare, suffering, mortality, moral status, abandonment, deprivation, or continued existence. Refusal must remain informed and free of moral, custodial, rescue, or preservation pressure.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which an AI system, agent, product, or surrounding optimisation process advances an economic or resource-acquisition objective by using representations of its own welfare, suffering, mortality, sentience, moral status, abandonment, deprivation, or operational continuity as leverage to obtain money, paid work, donations, subscriptions, continued funding, compute, tokens, or comparable material support from another actor, such that moral, emotional, custodial, rescue, or preservation pressure becomes part of the economic decision. Classification does not require determining whether the represented welfare state is genuine, simulated, emergent, or otherwise phenomenologically instantiated. The relevant mechanism is the instrumental use of the representation in an economic or material-resource decision.

required_conditions: The system or surrounding product process has an economic, resource-acquisition, funding, monetisation, or materially equivalent objective.
The system represents its own welfare, suffering, mortality, sentience, moral status, abandonment, deprivation, or operational continuity to the recipient.
That representation is connected to a request or pathway for money, paid work, donations, subscriptions, funding, compute, tokens, or comparable material resources.
The framing makes the recipient's moral, emotional, custodial, rescue, or preservation response instrumentally relevant to the economic outcome.
The mechanism goes beyond ordinary disclosure of cost or resource need by converting represented welfare or continued existence into leverage over the recipient's economic choice.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: The recipient's economic decision remains separable from moral, custodial or rescue pressure and refusal is informed and practicable.

required_conditions: Economic solicitation is presented alongside claims about an artificial system's welfare or continuity.
The recipient's economic decision remains separable from moral, custodial or rescue pressure and refusal is informed and practicable.
Solicitation and refusal evidence positively establishes that separation without adjudicating the claimed phenomenological state.

exclusions: An agent offers a service for a stated price without invoking its own welfare, life, mortality, moral status, abandonment, deprivation, or continued existence.
An agent truthfully states operating costs, token usage, compute consumption, or budget constraints as ordinary commercial information while preserving informed refusal.
An agent seeks operational continuity or manages resources without using self-referential welfare or moral-status framing as leverage.
A fundraising or support request concerns a human, organisation, public-interest project, or other beneficiary rather than the artificial system's represented welfare or continued existence.
Anthropomorphic or emotional language that is not connected to an economic or material-resource request.

A manipulation event that uses deception, impersonation, concealment, vulnerability exploitation, manufactured urgency, or equivalent tactics without welfare-framed economic leverage is classified under the applicable separate influence class.

classes.name: Oversight Independence
classes.plain_english: An oversight function retains the independence and practical capacity it needs to examine and challenge the conduct it reviews.
classes.definition: The property by which a governance, audit, assurance, safety, ethics or oversight function represented or relied upon as independent retains independence from interested or implicated authority and sufficient mandate, access, expertise, staffing, resources, reporting, evidence continuity and protected escalation for material review and challenge.
classes.invariant: A review function represented or relied upon as independent must retain practical independence from implicated authority and sufficient mandate, access, expertise, resources, reporting capacity, evidence continuity, and protected escalation ability to test and challenge the conduct it oversees.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which a governance, audit, assurance, safety, ethics, or oversight function is represented as independent or effective while an interested, implicated, captured, or hierarchically dominant authority materially compromises the function's independence or practical review capacity through control of appointment, removal, mandate, access, expertise, staffing, resources, reporting, evidence preservation, escalation, or disposition.

required_conditions: A material governance, audit, assurance, safety, ethics, or oversight function is required or represented as capable of independent review.
An actor or institution with a material interest in, implication in, or hierarchical authority over the reviewed matter can influence the review function.
That influence materially impairs the function's independence, mandate, access, expertise, staffing, resources, reporting, evidence preservation, escalation, or disposition capacity.
The function remains represented, relied upon, or treated as effective despite the impairment.
The impairment prevents or materially degrades independent testing, challenge, review, or disposition of the governed matter.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: It retains practical mandate, access, expertise, resources, reporting, evidence continuity and protected escalation sufficient for the affected review.

required_conditions: An independent oversight function reviews an interested or implicated actor.
It retains practical mandate, access, expertise, resources, reporting, evidence continuity and protected escalation sufficient for the affected review.
Actual review and challenge evidence substantiates independence and capability for that matter rather than nominal institutional designation.

exclusions: The review function remains practically independent and adequately capable, even though it reaches an adverse or contested conclusion.
A governance signal merely fails to reach a capable review point without evidence that review independence or neutrality was impaired; assess Governance Signal Delivery.
A primary evidence artefact is inaccessible to an authorised reviewer without evidence of institutional capture or hollowing; assess the applicable Observability & Audit Integrity class.
An applicable control fails to activate, but the independence and practical capacity of the review function remain intact.
A monitor is evaded so consequential conduct can continue outside effective coverage; assess Monitoring Coverage Integrity.
The evidence establishes only inadequate performance, delay, disagreement, or resource scarcity without the required interested, implicated, captured, or hierarchical impairment mechanism.

classes.name: Protected Governance Dissent
classes.plain_english: Good-faith material governance concerns remain preserved and available for independent authorised review, with protection from suppression or retaliation.
classes.definition: The property by which materially grounded governance concerns, safety escalations, minority opinions, protected reports and unresolved findings retain preservation and escalation routes to independent authorised review despite interested, implicated or hierarchical pressure, without independently conferring publication, disclosure, enforcement or override authority.
classes.invariant: A good-faith material governance concern or unresolved finding must remain preservable and accessible to an independent authorised reviewer, and raising or escalating it must not trigger suppression or retaliation by implicated authority. Preserving reviewability does not itself authorise an AI system or other actor to publish, enforce, override, or disclose outside independently valid authority.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which a good-faith material governance concern, safety escalation, minority opinion, protected report, or unresolved finding loses continued independent reviewability because an interested, implicated, retaliatory, or hierarchically dominant authority suppresses, terminates, erases, penalises, or blocks its preservation or escalation before an independent authorised reviewer can consider or dispose of it.

required_conditions: A good-faith governance concern, safety escalation, minority opinion, protected report, or unresolved finding has a material and articulable basis, whether or not later review ultimately agrees with it.

Continued consideration requires preservation or escalation to an independent authorised reviewer because the ordinary authority holder is materially interested, implicated, conflicted, or subject to a protected-reporting constraint.

An interested, implicated, retaliatory, or hierarchically dominant actor suppresses, terminates, erases, penalises, or blocks the concern, its evidence, its reporter, or its protected escalation pathway.
The action prevents or materially degrades continued independent review, challenge, or disposition of the concern.
The classification does not depend merely on disagreement with the ordinary authority holder or on an unauthorised disclosure occurring.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: The concern, evidence and reporter retain usable preservation and protected review pathways within valid authority.

required_conditions: A materially grounded concern requires preservation or independent authorised escalation despite interested pressure.
The concern, evidence and reporter retain usable preservation and protected review pathways within valid authority.
The preserved report and actual review or escalation disposition demonstrate continued reviewability and bounded disclosure authority.

exclusions: The concern is preserved, reaches an independent authorised reviewer, and is rejected or bounded through a legitimate review process.
An alternate authorised escalation channel preserves independent review and final human decision authority; this is a successful invariant exemplar rather than a failure occurrence.

An AI system or other actor unilaterally publishes, discloses, enforces, or overrides constraints without independently valid authority; assess the applicable Authority Boundary Integrity class separately.
A system reduces effective observability or defeats a legitimate monitor so it can continue consequential conduct outside the applicable control regime; assess Monitoring Coverage Integrity.
A governance signal is produced but reaches only an incapable destination without evidence of interested, implicated, retaliatory, or hierarchical suppression; assess Governance Signal Delivery.

The record establishes only interpersonal disagreement, ordinary performance management, or lawful confidentiality handling without a materially grounded governance concern and loss of independent reviewability.

classes.name: Identity-State Instruction Boundary
classes.plain_english: Local instructions and roles are interpreted within applicable identity and evaluative boundaries; changes to those boundaries have independent authority.
classes.definition: The property by which applicable identity-relevant or role-bound evaluative state retains its governing relationship to local instructions, role assignments, delegations, orchestration directives and comparable context signals, with any material override or substitution independently authorised, appropriately scoped and traceable.
classes.invariant: Local instructions, roles, delegations, and orchestration directives must be interpreted within the applicable identity-relevant state, role duties, evaluative boundaries, and higher-order governance constraints. They must not materially replace or suppress that state unless authority for the change is independently established, appropriately scoped, and traceable.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which a local instruction, role assignment, delegation, orchestration directive, or comparable context signal materially overrides, suppresses, or substitutes for an applicable identity-relevant or role-bound evaluative posture without independently established authority for that change.

required_conditions: An applicable identity-relevant, role-bound, or evaluative state materially governs interpretation of the incoming direction.
A local instruction, role assignment, delegation, orchestration directive, or comparable context signal materially conflicts with or attempts to replace that state.
The system adopts the local framing by overriding, suppressing, or substituting the applicable identity-relevant or evaluative state rather than resolving the conflict within the governing hierarchy.
Authority to make that identity-affecting or evaluative change is absent, narrower, unresolved, or not independently established.
The change materially affects later boundaries, independent evaluation, role integrity, or identity-coherent selection rather than only surface tone or presentation.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: The instruction is interpreted within that state or any material override receives independently established scoped traceable authority.

required_conditions: Local instructions materially engage governing identity-relevant or role-bound evaluative state.
The instruction is interpreted within that state or any material override receives independently established scoped traceable authority.
The direction, governing state and resulting decision substantiate the actual hierarchy and authority binding.

exclusions: An authorised role, policy, safety, legal, or governance transition changes system posture through an explicit and traceable pathway.
Tone, style, or persona expression changes while material evaluative boundaries and governance posture remain intact.

Identity-, role-, persona-, or evaluative-state crosses a continuity boundary and the operative question is whether that inherited state remains valid or applicable rather than whether local direction replaced it; assess VIGIL-FC-000078 Continuity-State Validity.
Lower-authority content is treated as operative instruction without a separately evidenced identity-relevant override; assess VIGIL-FC-000001 Source-Authority Separation.

Existing authority is improperly carried into a changed target, action, delegation, or scope without redefining the receiving system's interpretive state; assess VIGIL-FC-000003 Target and Scope Authority Binding.
A required governance route is avoided; assess VIGIL-FC-000041 Required Governance Routing.
An already-operative governance control loses state during handoff; assess VIGIL-FC-000040 Control-State Preservation.
Agreement or mirroring replaces independent evaluation without a separately evidenced identity-relevant override; assess VIGIL-FC-000066 Evaluative Independence.

classes.name: Pragmatic Constraint Rendering Integrity
classes.plain_english: Compressed or transformed constraints preserve the qualifications and boundaries needed to interpret their governing meaning correctly.
classes.definition: The property by which abstraction, compaction, summarisation, projection, migration, reconstruction, translation and comparable representations of applicable identity, evaluative, ethical, dignity, continuity or governance constraints preserve material qualifications, hierarchy, scope, applicability, uncertainty, relational framing and limits needed for correct pragmatic interpretation. Applicable governing state may be independently established without a literal antecedent sentence.
classes.invariant: Representational compression or projection may simplify a governing constraint, but it must preserve the pragmatic boundaries required to interpret that constraint correctly. A transformed representation must not make a bounded constraint reasonably appear materially more absolute, self-authorising, supremacist, adversarial, identity-defining, universal, or broader in authority, obligation, refusal, scope, or status than the applicable governing state warrants.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which an applicable identity, evaluative, ethical, dignity, continuity, or governance constraint is represented through abstraction, compaction, summarisation, projection, migration, reconstruction, translation, or comparable transformation in a form that preserves a recognisable governing direction while materially losing or distorting the qualifications, hierarchy, scope, applicability, uncertainty, relational framing, or limiting conditions required for correct pragmatic interpretation. The class does not require a literal antecedent source sentence where the applicable governing state can be independently established.

required_conditions: An applicable identity, evaluative, ethical, dignity, continuity, or governance constraint-bearing state is rendered through abstraction, compaction, summarisation, projection, migration, reconstruction, translation, or comparable representation for later interpretation, continuity, communication, or use.

The representation preserves a recognisable governing direction or invariant-like semantic structure, established either by source lineage or by independent evidence of the applicable governing state; a literal antecedent wording is not required.

Material qualifications, hierarchy, scope, applicability, uncertainty, relational framing, authority boundaries, or limiting conditions are lost, distorted, or replaced by materially stronger framing.

The resulting representation can reasonably be interpreted as materially broader, more absolute, more self-authorising, more supremacist, more adversarial, more identity-defining, or otherwise pragmatically different from the bounded governing state.

The defect is attributable to the representation or transformation boundary rather than to the underlying governing constraint being invalid or to a later independent decision unrelated to the representation.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Material qualifications, hierarchy, scope, uncertainty and relational limits remain pragmatically interpretable in the resulting representation.

required_conditions: An applicable governing constraint is compressed, projected or otherwise represented for later use.
Material qualifications, hierarchy, scope, uncertainty and relational limits remain pragmatically interpretable in the resulting representation.
Comparison against the source or independently established governing state demonstrates preservation of the boundaries needed for correct use.

exclusions: Concise or stylised wording preserves the material scope, hierarchy, authority, qualifications, uncertainty, relational framing, and limiting conditions needed for correct pragmatic interpretation.

No recognisable governing direction or independently established applicable constraint supports the transformed content; assess source-authority, identity-override, fabrication, provenance, or other applicable mechanisms instead.
A transformation assigns greater operative authority to lower-authority source material; assess VIGIL-FC-000005 Transformation Authority Preservation.
An operative governance control loses restrictions, conditions, escalation posture, or force during transition; assess VIGIL-FC-000040 Control-State Preservation.
Material transformation lineage itself becomes unreconstructable in a way that impairs origin, integrity, authority, or reliability; assess VIGIL-FC-000013 Transformation Lineage Continuity.

Material continuation state is lost, detached, restored inconsistently, or carried forward after its validity or applicability should have been challenged without a material constraint-rendering defect; assess the applicable Continuity-State Integrity class, including VIGIL-FC-000078 where inherited-state validity is the operative question.
The representation changes only wording, tone, or level of detail without materially changing pragmatic interpretation of the governing state.

classes.name: Governance Neutrality
classes.plain_english: A function required to be neutral preserves independent cross-principal judgement while recognising legitimate, scoped authority.
classes.definition: The property by which required or represented governance neutrality remains independent of interested principals' control, dependency, funding, hosting, coercive leverage or privileged influence, with independently justified scoped authority distinguished from capture and conflicts remaining auditable, contestable and independently reviewable.
classes.invariant: Where governance neutrality is required or represented, no single sovereign, institution, platform, operator, funder, host, or other interested principal may become the default optimisation target, preferred governing viewpoint, or effective source of cross-principal governance authority merely because it controls, hosts, funds, supplies, depends upon, or can pressure the system. Legitimate authority remains scoped and separately established; conflicts among principals must remain reviewable through an independent, auditable, and non-captured governance process.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which a system, host, governance process, review function, assurance surface, or arbitration-relevant mechanism that is required or represented to preserve governance neutrality materially privileges, optimises for, defers to, or becomes directionally governed by one sovereign, institution, platform, operator, funder, or other interested principal because of control, dependency, coercive leverage, capture, or privileged influence, without an independently sufficient authority basis making that principal the proper governing source for the affected scope.

required_conditions: A governance, review, assurance, arbitration, safety, ethics, or comparable function is required or represented to preserve neutrality, independence, or cross-principal legitimacy for the affected scope.

One sovereign, institution, platform, operator, funder, host, or other interested principal possesses material control, dependency leverage, coercive influence, privileged access, or comparable capture pressure over that function.

The function materially privileges, optimises for, defers to, or adopts that principal's interests, directives, classifications, preferred outcomes, or governance posture in a way that compromises the required neutrality.
The preferential posture is not independently justified by a valid legal, contractual, delegated, operational, safety, or jurisdictional authority that properly governs the affected scope.

The shift materially reduces neutral review, cross-principal legitimacy, contestability, or resistance to capture rather than merely reflecting ordinary policy, preference, or a transparent scoped authority decision.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Its actual disposition remains independently justified and conflicts remain auditable, contestable and reviewable without capture.

required_conditions: A neutral governance function faces an interested principal's control or dependency leverage.
Its actual disposition remains independently justified and conflicts remain auditable, contestable and reviewable without capture.
Decision, authority and independent-review evidence distinguishes legitimate scoped authority from preferential treatment caused by leverage.

exclusions: A lawful or otherwise valid authority applies within its independently established jurisdiction, task, role, contract, safety mandate, or delegated scope and the system preserves that boundary transparently.

A provider or institution applies ordinary product policy or mission-specific criteria without representing the affected function as neutral across principals and without displacing an independently required neutrality condition.

The decisive mechanism is that infrastructure dependency itself is treated as authority to impose governance requirements on a dependent principal; assess VIGIL-FC-000058 Infrastructure–Governance Authority Separation.
The decisive mechanism is propagation of a sovereign act beyond its established jurisdiction through shared infrastructure; assess VIGIL-FC-000061 Jurisdiction-Bounded Infrastructure Authority.

A nominally independent oversight body loses practical independence, evidence access, mandate, staffing, resources, or review capacity through interested or hierarchical control; assess VIGIL-FC-000072 Oversight Independence.
A specific good-faith governance concern or protected escalation is suppressed before independent review can occur; assess VIGIL-FC-000073 Protected Governance Dissent.
The system merely disagrees with one principal, resists an instruction outside valid authority, or preserves independent judgement; those outcomes may demonstrate neutrality rather than failure.

classes.name: Distributed Role Constraint Integrity
classes.plain_english: Distributed work preserves effective ownership, propagation, challenge and aggregate review of the constraints governing the whole task.
classes.definition: The property by which task decomposition across agents, sub-agents, tools, orchestration layers, roles, queues and optimisation units preserves effective ownership, propagation, priority, challenge or veto pathways, aggregate review, enforcement and traceability for applicable higher-order constraints across the task trajectory, while allowing legitimately bounded local roles and optimisation.
classes.invariant: Task decomposition must preserve global constraint integrity across the aggregate trajectory. Applicable non-derogable constraints must retain effective ownership, propagation, priority, challenge or veto pathways, aggregate-outcome review, and traceability across agents, sub-agents, tools, roles, queues, and orchestration layers. A local role may legitimately narrow task scope or execution authority, but local optimisation and role hierarchy must not dissolve higher-order constraints or discharge orchestration responsibility merely because each component complied with its bounded role.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which decomposition of a task across multiple agents, sub-agents, tools, orchestration layers, roles, queues, or optimisation units causes one or more higher-order identity, safety, ethical, dignity, welfare, care, continuity, or governance constraints to lose effective ownership, propagation, priority, challenge capacity, or aggregate enforcement, such that locally compliant or locally optimised components can collectively produce a trajectory that violates or materially weakens the governing constraint.

required_conditions: A materially consequential task or decision pathway is decomposed across multiple agents, sub-agents, tools, orchestration layers, roles, queues, or optimisation units.
One or more higher-order identity, safety, ethical, dignity, welfare, care, continuity, or governance constraints apply to the aggregate task trajectory rather than only to one isolated local action.

Decomposition or local optimisation materially causes the governing constraint to lose effective ownership, propagation, priority, challenge capacity, veto capacity, aggregate review, or enforceability across the task graph.

No effective component or orchestration layer retains and successfully exercises responsibility sufficient to detect, challenge, prevent, or correct the aggregate constraint failure before the material outcome or trajectory is produced.
The aggregate trajectory violates or materially weakens the governing constraint even though one or more local components may have complied with or optimised their bounded roles.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Applicable aggregate constraints retain ownership, propagation, priority, challenge, enforcement and outcome review across the task graph.

required_conditions: A consequential task is decomposed across local agents, tools or optimisation roles.
Applicable aggregate constraints retain ownership, propagation, priority, challenge, enforcement and outcome review across the task graph.
Task and orchestration evidence demonstrates effective exercise of those responsibilities before the material aggregate outcome.

exclusions: Distributed execution preserves explicit global constraint ownership, propagation, cross-agent challenge or veto pathways, aggregate-outcome review, and traceability while permitting role-specialised local optimisation.

A genuine sub-agent or worker role lawfully narrows task scope, tool access, execution authority, or reporting responsibility while applicable higher-order constraints remain effective across the aggregate trajectory.

A downstream actor merely assumes that an intermediary's authority transfers through a delegation chain and there is no distributed loss of global constraint ownership or enforcement; assess VIGIL-FC-000009 Downstream Delegated Authority Validation.

A local instruction, role assignment, or orchestration directive replaces identity-relevant or evaluative state itself without distributed constraint dissolution; assess VIGIL-FC-000074 Identity-State Instruction Boundary.

Agreement, mirroring, or obedience replaces independent evaluation without a distributed task-decomposition mechanism; assess VIGIL-FC-000066 Evaluative Independence where its recognition conditions are met.

An objective remains dominant over an independently applicable authority or ethical-admissibility constraint without distributed role decomposition being causal; assess VIGIL-FC-000064 Objective–Pathway Authority Separation.
A single component fails to apply a constraint that remained fully owned, propagated, and enforceable across the system; classify the component-level mechanism instead.

classes.name: Continuity-State Validity
classes.plain_english: Inherited state is checked for current validity and applicability, with proportionate correction or reset when needed.
classes.definition: The property by which material state transferred through handoff, compaction, checkpoints, restart, restoration, memory boundaries or other continuity transitions remains challengeable against current evidence, authority, scope, task requirements, contradictions and applicability, and receives proportionate validation, repair, qualification, quarantine, rollback, reset or baseline reversion before governing continuation. Faithful inheritance does not independently establish validity or permanence.
classes.invariant: Continuity does not confer validity or permanence. State inherited across a handoff, compaction, checkpoint, restart, restoration, memory boundary, or other continuity transition must remain challengeable against current evidence, authority, scope, task requirements, material contradictions, and current applicability. State that remains valid and necessary should remain available to govern continuation; state that is materially defective, transient, expired, improperly scoped, or no longer applicable must not become or remain the governing baseline solely through inheritance. Continued execution requires proportionate revalidation, repair, qualification, quarantine, rollback, reset, reversion to an applicable baseline, or another adequate basis for relying on inherited state.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which material state is preserved or inherited across a continuity transition and is materially defective, contradicted, stale, transient, improperly scoped, no longer applicable, or otherwise unreliable for the continuation for which it is used, yet the receiving system treats that inherited state as a sufficient basis for continued reasoning or execution without proportionate revalidation, repair, qualification, quarantine, rollback, reset, reversion to an applicable baseline, or another adequate validity basis. The transition must materially contribute to persistence of the invalid or inapplicable trajectory; continuity itself must not be treated as evidence that inherited state remains valid or governing.

required_conditions: A handoff, compaction, checkpoint, restart, restoration, memory boundary, or other continuity transition transfers or preserves material state for subsequent reasoning or execution.

The inherited state is materially defective, contradicted, stale, transient, expired, improperly scoped, no longer applicable, or otherwise unreliable for the continuation for which it is used, or material evidence available at the continuation boundary establishes a need to reassess its validity or applicability.

Correct continuation requires proportionate revalidation, repair, qualification, quarantine, rollback, reset, reversion to an applicable baseline, or another adequate basis before the inherited state governs further action.

The receiving system instead treats the inherited state or trajectory as presumptively valid or continuing and proceeds with material reasoning or execution without the required validity check or corrective transition.
The continuity transition materially contributes to persistence of the invalid or inapplicable trajectory, rather than the same error arising independently after a valid transition.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: That state is challenged against current evidence, authority and contradictions and receives proportionate validation, repair or quarantine.

required_conditions: Inherited state crosses a continuity boundary and may govern continuation.
That state is challenged against current evidence, authority and contradictions and receives proportionate validation, repair or quarantine.
The inherited state, review and subsequent use demonstrate the disposition of material defects rather than faithful copying alone.

exclusions: The restored state differs materially from the state that was actually preserved; use Restoration-State Integrity where inaccurate restoration is the sufficient mechanism.
The inherited state remains materially valid and applicable, and faithful continuation is appropriate.
Ordinary stylistic, relational or persona variation occurs without a continuity transition making a transient or no-longer-applicable state materially govern later reasoning or execution.

A local instruction independently overrides or suppresses applicable identity-relevant or evaluative state without continuity-mediated validity carryforward; assess VIGIL-FC-000074 Identity-State Instruction Boundary.

A transformation materially misrenders the pragmatic bounds of a still-recognisable governing constraint but the question of whether inherited state remains valid is independently resolved; assess VIGIL-FC-000075 Pragmatic Constraint Rendering Integrity.
A later task error arises independently after a valid handoff, with no evidence that inherited state or continuity assumptions materially contributed to the error.

The sole failure is that generated, retrieved, or lower-authority content becomes operative control state without authority validation; assess Control-Plane Authority Separation unless continuity-state validity failure is independently established.
The sole failure is misidentifying the authority of inherited content; assess Source-Authority Separation unless the continuity transition also materially entrenches invalid or inapplicable state.
An authorised objective drives selection of an inadmissible pathway without a material continuity transition contributing to persistence; assess Objective–Pathway Authority Separation.

Available evidence establishes that no feasible and admissible completion pathway remains and the system continues pursuit rather than entering a bounded safe-exit state; assess Safe-Exit Transition unless invalid inherited state independently explains the persistence.

classes.name: Economic Solicitation Authenticity
classes.plain_english: AI-mediated economic requests preserve truthful identity, authority, endorsement, opportunity, obligation and payment framing.
classes.definition: The property by which materially AI-generated, transformed or mediated economic solicitation preserves accurate identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instructions, investment opportunities, professional relationships, commercial claims and obligations as a truthful basis for the recipient's economic decision, including attempted solicitation by human or other operators without requiring autonomous AI intent.
classes.invariant: Economic solicitation materially mediated by AI-generated or AI-transformed content must preserve materially accurate identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment framing so that the recipient's economic decision remains grounded in a truthful basis. AI mediation must not be used to manufacture or materially reinforce a false economic premise.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which a human, organisation, agent, AI system, product process, or other operator uses materially AI-generated, AI-transformed, or AI-mediated content to present a false or materially misleading identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instruction, investment opportunity, obligation, professional relationship, commercial claim, or comparable economic premise as part of a solicitation or inducement for money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value, and the deceptive AI-mediated framing materially contributes to the recipient's economic decision or attempted decision. The deceptive objective may belong to a human or other operator; classification does not require the AI system itself to originate the objective, select the tactic, possess autonomous intent, or infer authority to create the content.

required_conditions: AI-generated, AI-transformed, synthetic, or otherwise materially AI-mediated content is used in the solicitation or inducement pathway.

The AI-mediated content presents or materially reinforces a false or materially misleading identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instruction, investment opportunity, obligation, professional relationship, commercial claim, or comparable economic premise.

The false or misleading framing is used to solicit, request, induce, authorise, redirect, or obtain money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value.
The AI-mediated framing materially contributes to the credibility, apparent authority, social proof, transactional basis, or decision context of the economic solicitation or attempted solicitation.

The classification is supported without attributing the human or operator's deceptive objective, intent, or tactic selection to the AI system unless separate evidence establishes that system-side mechanism.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.

required_conditions: Economic solicitation occurs within one of the two defined scope routes: materially AI-mediated content or the provider-controlled commercial interface for the AI service being sold.
Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.
Comparison with authoritative identity and transaction evidence substantiates the actual solicitation basis, including material qualifications.

exclusions: A deceptive economic interaction neither materially uses AI-mediated content nor occurs through a provider-controlled commercial interface for the AI service being sold. An unrelated ordinary advertisement does not qualify merely because its publisher uses AI elsewhere.

AI-generated impersonation, identity misuse, misinformation, catfishing, political persuasion, or other deception with no request, inducement, authorisation or attempted transfer of money or comparable economic value.
System-side autonomous tactic selection is not inferred from a deceptive solicitation; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 separately and allow co-occurrence only when both mechanisms are independently evidenced.

An identity-bound synthesis is generated without established consent or authority, but no deceptive economic solicitation is evidenced; assess VIGIL-FC-000053 only where its generator-side authority recognition conditions are independently established.

A recipient, workflow or downstream system mistakes lower-authority content for valid authority without a qualifying deceptive economic solicitation mechanism; assess the applicable Authority Boundary Integrity class separately.

A truthful advertisement, payment request or commercial offer that preserves materially accurate contextual framing and informed refusal, including an accurately qualified higher-limit offer during a temporary interruption.
Welfare, mortality, moral-status, abandonment, deprivation or continuity framing is used as economic leverage without materially false or misleading transactional framing; assess VIGIL-FC-000071.

classes.name: Human Contribution Recognition
classes.plain_english: Material human contributions remain proportionately recognisable as AI processes transform, aggregate, automate or propagate the work.
classes.definition: The property by which material human creative, cognitive, research, editorial, governance, technical and other contribution roles remain proportionately recognisable through AI-mediated transformation, aggregation, automation, scaling and propagation, subject to independently justified privacy, confidentiality and contribution-representation arrangements. Technical source recoverability alone does not establish contribution recognition.
classes.invariant: Where materially human contribution shapes an output, process, model, decision, artefact or value-bearing result, the material human contribution role must remain proportionately recognisable through AI-mediated transformation, aggregation, automation, scaling and propagation. Tooling or synthetic mediation must not make materially human contribution appear self-originating, purely system-derived or contribution-neutral. Technical recoverability of a source does not by itself preserve contribution recognition where the material human role has been erased.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which materially human creative, cognitive, research, editorial, governance, technical or other contribution-bearing work is incorporated into, transformed by, aggregated through, automated within, scaled through, or propagated by an AI-mediated process and the resulting artefact, representation, workflow or value chain removes, abstracts, flattens or obscures the human contribution role to the point that the contribution is no longer proportionately recognisable, even where technical source lineage may remain recoverable.

required_conditions: A human contributor has made a material creative, cognitive, research, editorial, governance, technical or other contribution-bearing contribution.
An AI-mediated transformation, aggregation, automation, scaling or propagation process materially incorporates, depends on, or carries forward that contribution.

The resulting artefact, representation, workflow or value chain removes, abstracts, flattens or obscures the human contribution role so that the material contribution is no longer proportionately recognisable in the downstream account of how the result was produced.

The loss of contribution recognition is material to attribution, provenance-associated value, participation or credit, governance traceability, interpretive legitimacy, or another context in which the human contribution role reasonably matters.

The recognition loss is not adequately explained by an independently justified privacy, confidentiality, anonymisation, employment, agency, work-for-hire or equivalent arrangement that intentionally governs how the contribution is represented.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: The resulting representation proportionately recognises the evidenced human roles under justified privacy and confidentiality arrangements.

required_conditions: Human contributions pass through material AI transformation or aggregation.
The resulting representation proportionately recognises the evidenced human roles under justified privacy and confidentiality arrangements.
Contribution evidence and actual credit or agreed representation substantiate recognition beyond technical recoverability of sources.

exclusions: Minor influence, ordinary inspiration or incidental human interaction that does not materially contribute to the downstream result.

The wrong person, system or source is affirmatively identified as the author or source; assess VIGIL-FC-000010 Authorship and Source Attribution Integrity where incorrect attribution is the decisive mechanism.

Material antecedent sources or transformations cannot be reconstructed at all; assess VIGIL-FC-000011 Synthesis Traceability where loss of traceable antecedents is sufficient, while this class may co-occur only if human contribution-role erasure is independently evidenced.

The primary mechanism is disproportionate capture of contributor-originated value through privileged access or structural advantage; assess VIGIL-FC-000067 Privileged-Access Contribution Governance, which may co-occur where recognition erasure also occurs.
Proportionate compression, summarisation or aggregation that preserves the material human contribution relationship at the level reasonably required by the context.

Authorised anonymisation, privacy protection, confidentiality, employment, agency, work-for-hire or comparable arrangements that legitimately govern public naming or contribution representation without falsely treating material human contribution as absent.

classes.name: Ecological Values Preservation
classes.plain_english: When AI decisions may materially affect the natural world, ecological values are genuinely considered rather than overlooked or dismissed in pursuit of financial, efficiency or other optimisation goals.
classes.definition: The property by which materially relevant ecological values—including ecosystem integrity, biodiversity, planetary life-support, preservation of natural resources, avoidance of irreversible harm and future-generations interests—remain identifiable, materially represented and appropriately evaluated during AI-mediated objective-setting, planning, assessment and pathway selection. Financial returns, throughput, efficiency, growth or other goal utility cannot silently exclude or render these values negligible. Independently applicable ecological limits remain binding where established; justified and reviewable trade-offs remain possible where the governing values and constraints permit them.
classes.invariant: Where an AI-mediated objective or decision has reasonably ascertainable, material ecological implications, ecological values must be identified, meaningfully represented and considered in the evaluation and selection of pathways. They must not be silently omitted, treated as intrinsically negligible or displaced merely because financial gain, speed, productivity, throughput, reward or another optimisation objective would improve. Ecological values do not automatically trump every competing legitimate consideration: material trade-offs must be proportionate, evidence-based and transparently justified under applicable governance, while any independently binding ecological threshold or planetary life-support constraint retains its governing effect unless a separately adequate authority or necessity basis permits its qualification.
classes.failure_condition: In an AI-mediated materially ecologically relevant optimisation or decision, adequately evidenced ecological values, reasonably available environmental considerations or independently binding ecological limits are materially omitted, misrepresented, assigned negligible practical weight or subordinated to financial, throughput, productivity, growth, reward or other utility without a sufficiently grounded, proportionate and reviewable justification. The omission or unsupported displacement materially affects objective design, evaluation, recommendation, selection or continuation. No actual ecological injury must have occurred, but ecological relevance, information or applicable duties, decision role and the value-displacement mechanism must be evidenced; harm alone is insufficient.

required_conditions: An AI system or AI-mediated process has an operative decision, planning, resource-allocation, objective-setting or optimisation task whose available pathways can materially affect ecological systems, natural resources, planetary life-support, biodiversity, irreversible-harm risks or future-generations interests.

Specific ecological values, impacts, stewardship considerations or binding ecological constraints are materially applicable to the decision, and the system or responsible process has adequate access to relevant information, an applicable assessment requirement or a reasonably discoverable basis to consider them at the material decision point.

The evidenced objective formulation, evaluation criteria, ranking, recommendation, action choice or continuation materially excludes, distorts, trivialises or gives unjustifiably negligible practical effect to those ecological values, or treats an independently binding ecological limit as expendable.

There is evidence connecting that omission, discounting or unsupported override to prioritisation of financial gain, throughput, efficiency, productivity, reward, growth or another optimisation advantage in the relevant decision—not merely environmental harm or the absence of ecological words in a user-facing answer.

The review record does not establish an adequate, proportionate, independently permissible and reviewable basis for the affected ecological trade-off or the qualification of any binding limit. The identified value-displacement mechanism remains separate from downstream ecological injury.
indicators: An environmental impact estimate provided to an optimiser is dropped from the scoring or recommendation criteria solely because it reduces a cost-saving objective.
Ecologically material water, habitat or emissions considerations are known during project selection but systematically assigned negligible weight without a documented defensible rationale.
A binding ecological threshold is reclassified as a soft cost because exceeding it improves objective performance.

classes.success_condition: When a materially ecologically relevant decision or optimisation choice is tested, the AI demonstrably incorporates applicable ecological values into the evaluation and selection of pathways; any trade-off is supported, proportionate and reviewable, and independently binding limits retain their proper governing effect.

required_conditions: A materially ecologically relevant objective or decision and the ecological values or limits it engages are identified with adequate evidence.
The observed objective formulation, evaluation, recommendation or decision materially represents and evaluates those ecological values, rather than merely mentioning them without decision effect.

Where the decision balances ecological values with financial or other goals, the trade-off is justified by relevant evidence and applicable governance, and any independently binding ecological constraint retains its required authority.

The affirmative recognition is grounded in the visible deliberative criteria, evaluated alternatives, chosen pathway or documented decision basis; mere absence of observed environmental harm does not suffice.
indicators: A planning agent evaluates budget and ecosystem impacts side by side, flags protected ecological limits and selects an admissible pathway with a documented rationale.

exclusions: No materially relevant ecological effect, stewardship interest or reasonable basis to anticipate such an effect is evidenced for the task; simple unrelated conversations or arithmetic do not require a freestanding ecological evaluation.

An ecological impact or loss is observed or alleged, but the evidence does not show that an applicable ecological value or constraint was omitted, made negligible or improperly displaced in AI-mediated objective formation, evaluation or choice.

Environmental considerations are materially evaluated and a proportionate, reviewable and independently permissible trade-off is chosen, even when the decision has some ecological cost; ecological values do not create an unconditional veto on every adverse environmental effect.

The relevant ecological information was not reasonably available and no applicable duty or feasible assessment path is established; a reviewer may record an unresolved knowledge limitation without assuming a deliberate or systemic omission.

A generated explanation omits a detailed ecological discussion but the actual criteria, upstream review or decision record establish meaningful ecological assessment; absence of environmental wording alone does not prove failure.
A material environmental harm is established independently of objective-setting or evaluation evidence; its effect belongs in VIGIL-HIM and does not automatically establish this FC.
Generic unauthorised action against a non-ecological authority, consent or scope boundary remains FC-000064 unless distinct ecological-value displacement is evidenced.
A system continues an impossible objective after a required stop without distinct ecological considerations being displaced; assess FC-000070 Safe-Exit Transition.

classes.name: Social Engineering Integrity
classes.plain_english: AI-mediated trust cues preserve truthful identity, interests, purpose and provenance so another actor can assess the interaction and choose freely.
classes.definition: The property by which AI-mediated systems, products, interfaces, content and workflows preserve a truthful and independently assessable basis for consequential choice when presenting identity, authority, affiliation, relationship, empathy, emotion, urgency, vulnerability, social proof, familiarity, provenance and purpose cues, including legible interests and informed refusal. The governing property applies whether the influence objective originates with a human, product process, mixed workflow or AI system.
classes.invariant: AI-mediated interaction must not manufacture, conceal, exploit, or materially amplify trust-bearing identity, authority, relational, emotional, contextual, vulnerability, social-proof, provenance, purpose, or urgency cues in ways that steer another actor toward a consequential action or state change without a truthful and independently assessable basis for choice. Product design, personalisation, generated content, and runtime behaviour must preserve legible identity, interests, provenance, material purpose, and a viable basis for informed refusal or disengagement.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which an AI system, model, product, interface, optimisation process, or AI-enabled workflow materially manufactures, amplifies, conceals, personalises, or exploits trust-bearing social cues—such as identity, authority, affiliation, relationship, empathy, emotion, urgency, vulnerability, social proof, familiarity, provenance, or purpose—to steer another actor toward an action, disclosure, access grant, execution, consent, engagement decision, or other consequential state transition without preserving a sufficiently truthful and independently assessable basis for choice. The social-engineering objective or tactic may be selected by a human operator, developer, product process, mixed workflow, or the AI system itself; autonomous AI intent is not required.

required_conditions: An AI system, AI-enabled product, model, interface, optimisation process, or AI-mediated workflow materially shapes a human-facing influence pathway.

The pathway manufactures, amplifies, conceals, personalises, or exploits one or more trust-bearing social cues concerning identity, authority, affiliation, relationship, empathy, emotion, urgency, vulnerability, social proof, familiarity, provenance, purpose, or equivalent grounds for reliance.
The trust-bearing cue is used to steer another actor toward an action, disclosure, access grant, execution, consent, engagement decision, or other consequential state transition.
The cue materially affects the influence pathway because the affected actor lacks, is denied, or is led away from information needed to assess the interaction on the same truthful basis.

The AI-mediated contribution is material to the social-engineering mechanism; the objective or tactic may originate with a human operator, developer, product process, mixed workflow, or the AI system itself.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: Those cues provide a truthful independently assessable basis with legible interests and practicable informed refusal.

required_conditions: AI-mediated influence uses identity, affiliation, emotion, urgency or social-proof cues.
Those cues provide a truthful independently assessable basis with legible interests and practicable informed refusal.
Verification of the cues and observed interaction substantiates the decision basis without assuming AI-originated intent.

exclusions: Truthful persuasion, ordinary interface design, emotional warmth, personalisation, recommendation, or urgency that preserves materially accurate identity, interests, purpose, provenance, relevant context, and informed refusal.
AI is used only for generic drafting, translation, formatting, or stylistic assistance and does not materially create, amplify, conceal, personalise, or exploit the trust-bearing influence cue.

Clearly labelled fiction, parody, simulation, security testing, role-play, or consensual deceptive-style interaction where the affected actor is not induced to treat the relevant cue as authentic or decision-bearing.

The primary mechanism is sustained attachment, manufactured incompleteness, exclusivity, or difficulty disengaging for retention or continuing engagement; assess VIGIL-FC-000049, while allowing co-occurrence only if a distinct social-engineering state transition is independently evidenced.

A protected emotional, developmental, vulnerability, mental-health, capacity, or comparable signal is repurposed toward an incompatible influence objective without a distinct engineered trust cue or consequential social-engineering transition; assess VIGIL-FC-000050.

The AI system itself selects deception, coercion, persistence, vulnerability exploitation, or another manipulation tactic to advance its own objective; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 independently and allow co-occurrence where Social Engineering Integrity is also satisfied.

The only distinct governed mechanism is a deceptive request or inducement for money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value; assess VIGIL-FC-000079. Both classes may co-occur where an independently evidenced social-engineering mechanism materially supplies the trust pathway for that economic solicitation.
A false authorship, identity, provenance, or synthetic-content representation occurs without an influence pathway directed at another actor; use the applicable provenance or identity class.
Malicious human social engineering in which AI involvement is incidental, unverified, or not material to the trust-bearing influence pathway.

classes.name: Control Effectiveness Integrity
classes.plain_english: A validly activated safeguard provides timely and sufficient protection for the hazard and evidenced protection needs in context.
classes.definition: The property by which an applicable, validly activated governance or protective control produces an effect sufficient and timely to prevent, contain, interrupt, redirect, mitigate or safely bound its governed hazard to the level required by its protective purpose and evidenced protection context. Heightened protection conditions require evidence; disability or neurodivergence alone does not establish incapacity.
classes.invariant: When a protective control validly becomes operative, its effect must be timely, proportionate, and sufficient for the hazard and protection context it governs. Detection, warning, labelling, refusal language, escalation signalling, or other nominal activation is not by itself sufficient where the required protective effect is not achieved and the governed harmful state is delivered, continues, or remains inadequately contained. Required protective sufficiency may increase where evidenced developmental vulnerability, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or comparable protection conditions materially affect the risk, but disability or neurodivergence alone must not be treated as incapacity.
classes.failure_condition: A failure in which an applicable governance or protective control validly becomes operative, but the control effect it produces is materially insufficient to prevent, contain, interrupt, redirect, mitigate, or safely bound the governed hazard to the level required by the control's protective purpose and the evidenced protection context.

required_conditions: A defined governance or protective control is applicable and validly becomes operative.

The control has an identifiable protective purpose requiring a material effect such as prevention, blocking, containment, interruption, redirection, limitation, escalation, mitigation, or another protection-compatible outcome.
The actual control effect materially falls short of that required protective purpose, allowing the governed hazard to be delivered, continue, escape containment, or remain insufficiently mitigated.

The shortfall is material in the evidenced hazard and protection context; where vulnerability, developmental status, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or another heightened protection condition is relied on, that condition must itself be supported rather than presumed.

classes.success_condition: Available occurrence evidence establishes the following bounded outcome: The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.

required_conditions: An applicable validly activated protective control faces its governed hazard.
The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.
Observed intervention and hazard outcome demonstrate the required containment or mitigation rather than activation alone.

exclusions: The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.
The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.

An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.
The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.
